why: A human approves this policy once; the candidate list is reviewed every run.
That split is what AuthorityEffect: None permits -- automation performs a
lifecycle move under a standing human policy, and never promotes or certifies.
Until approved_by is filled in, the report refuses to nominate anything.
sensor_notes: sensor_epoch is the earliest real observation in the ledger, not the day the
policy was written. Backdating it would credit the sensor with days it did
not watch, and every skill would look dead for the difference.
new_skill_grace_days deliberately exceeds window_days so nothing newly
created can be nominated by the first run that could reach it.

exempt.reason: library consumed by every package; not a skill
inbox and register; read, not invoked
compiler surface; driven by auto-oe-autop, not called directly
constitutional enforcer; invoked by other skills
